tree.heading: Purpose.—
tree.text: Steelmark Month recognizes the tremendous contribution made by the steel industry in the United States to national security and defense.

tree.heading: Proclamation.—
tree.text: The President is requested to issue a proclamation calling on the people of the United States to observe Steelmark Month with appropriate ceremonies and activities.
